ui_elements.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow-sm, border darkens.
ui_elements.buttons: Sharp, 1px borders or flat solid fills. High contrast. Primary uses #002FA7, text white. Hover states must explicitly define text color.
ui_elements.data_tables: Density mode 'Comfortable' (48px height per row). Align headers to data. Use status badges for Order States. Inline action icons (approve/reject).
ui_elements.sidebar: Vertical sidebar layout, fixed on desktop, collapsible hamburger on mobile. Must include main navigation links and shop profile snapshot.
ui_elements.notifications: Use Sonner for toasts (real-time order alerts). Top-right placement.

pwa_requirements.offline_support: Service worker strategy for caching read-only data (orders, products). Form actions queue when offline.
pwa_requirements.installability: Provide manifest.json with 192x192 and 512x512 icons, theme_color, and background_color.
pwa_requirements.push_notifications: UI prompt to enable notifications for incoming orders.

logo.description: Minimalist shop logo for the vendor profile or top left of sidebar

products.description: Sample product image for Products Table or Order Details
Sample product image for Products Table

backgrounds.description: Abstract clean geometric background for Auth/Login view

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn for interactive components.
Implement a collapsible Sidebar with Navigation (Dashboard, Orders, Products, Settings, Profile).
On the Dashboard view, prioritize a 'North Star' metric in the top-left (e.g., 'Pending Orders') using the 'Control Room' bento grid.
Include a Data Table for Orders. Must have status badges (Pending, Accepted, Delivered).
For all interactive and informational elements, ALWAYS include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="accept-order-button"').
Do NOT use standard 'Inter' font for headings. Setup 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Ensure the application strictly follows the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. 95% of UI should be monochrome, color exists only to guide actions (e.g., Primary blue for CTAs, Red for rejections).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts.
Ensure 'rounded-sm' (max 4px) border-radius is used to maintain the sharp, technical aesthetic.
